chunks.title: Water Dispenser General Specs
chunks.content: All PEL Water Dispensers come with a 1-Year Warranty (compressor and parts). They feature food-grade stainless steel tanks, 95 Watt Cooling Power (3.7 Liters capacity), 500 Watt Heating Power (1.2 Liters capacity), and use R134a refrigerant (38 grams).

chunks.series: Curved Glass, Flat Glass, Premier, Smart
chunks.title: Models with Built-in Refrigerator
chunks.content: The Curved Glass Door series (PCWD-525, 3 taps), Flat Glass Door series (PWD-425, 3 taps), and the freestanding Premier (PWD-316) and Smart (PWD-315) series include a built-in cool cabinet (refrigerator) capable of storing food/drinks down to 3°C. The Premier has a 20L volume, while the others have an 18L volume.

chunks.title: Models WITHOUT Refrigerator
chunks.content: Important distinction: The Pearl Basic Series (PWD-215) and Table Top (PWD-115 TT) DO NOT have a refrigerator compartment. The Pearl Basic only has a non-refrigerated storage cabinet.
